evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames self-origination and retention of capability as the appealed-to good, carrying both autonomy (owning what is yours) and self-enhancement (keeping the asset).

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Perspective-as-kept-asset appeals to self-origination (your own perspective) and the mastery-quality of that perspective as the durable value, opposing it to the commodity substrate.

mints.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
mints.title: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence
mints.frame: Does the expression appeal to owning and keeping one's own intelligence or perspective as a value, opposing it to renting or commodifying that capability?
